## Required

Four fields: trip ID and responses for the line setter/shooter, line hauler and bait-casting machine.

## Available

In the 2025 selection, shooter use is recorded on 21 sets: one observer-monitored and 20 self-reporting sets.

This is evidence of use, subject to confirming that the source device matches the ROS equipment.

No mitigation-device categories were selected. That does not prove bait-casting equipment was absent.

No reliable line-hauler evidence has been established.

## To decide

Distinguish equipment available on a trip from equipment used on a set; agree trip-level reporting rules.

Choose NAV for information not collected, or UNK when undetermined at collection, only when justified.

A default-false flag does not prove absence. Equipment mappings and delivery levels remain open.

The sheet may be empty structurally; reported configurations/devices still need a gear parent in the database.

IOTC reporting and importer rules remain open.
